say:0:1011322001:0.text: Ugh, all I hear is the flowing water and the buzz of insects.
say:0:1011322001:0.source_cn: 满耳都是流水声和虫鸣，睡不着……
say:0:1011322001:0.male: Ugh, all I hear is the flowing water and the buzz of insects.
say:0:1011322001:0.female: Ugh, all I hear is the flowing water and the buzz of insects.

say:1:1011322002:0.text: I should go take a walk. I might find others struggling to sleep.
say:1:1011322002:0.source_cn: 在村里逛逛，欣赏一下夜景吧。或许也有失眠的人……
